note: Adapted from Chhotani's (1997) species description; the original is in English, and both the soldier and the worker are described by comparison with D. gravelyi without measurements; the detailed description and illustrations are in Thakur and Chatterjee (1971); the alate is unknown; distribution records, figure numbers and taxonomic discussion are not included.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: The soldier is very close to D. gravelyi in body size, mandibular and labral shape and degree of frontal inclination, differing only in subtle characters: the sides of the head slightly convex and weakly convergent anteriorly, the anterior lateral tubercles slightly longer, and the base of the anterolateral margin of the labrum projecting rather than weakly serrate; the worker is also very similar to D. gravelyi. The separation of the two is provisional: no type material of D. gravelyi was available at the time, the soldier specimens of that species available for examination were very few, and its range of variation could not be studied; if longer series become available, the characters used to separate them may not hold.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Sides of the head slightly convex, weakly convergent anteriorly; anterior lateral tubercles slightly longer than in D. gravelyi; base of the anterolateral margin of the labrum projecting, whereas it is weakly serrate in D. gravelyi. Body size, mandibular shape, labral shape and degree of frontal inclination all close to D. gravelyi, the differences lying only in the subtle characters noted above.
